entries.00a4df242b1647d3: This is a single-segment business that provides listed companies and issuers of financial instruments with integrated practical support for statutory disclosure and IR. The group consists of the company and 16 consolidated subsidiaries, and consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,821 million. It combines consulting and outsourcing by specialists, IT services such as disclosure document preparation support systems, and content production services such as Web production, translation, video production, data processing and printing. The services handled are divided into 4 categories: listed company disclosure-related, listed company IR and event-related, financial instrument disclosure-related, and database-related.

entries.153cb2d8c012cc4c: Under the 'New Medium-Term Management Plan 2027' announced in May 2025 (covering April 2025 to March 2028), its priority strategies are: strengthening the existing disclosure and IR business (raising the market share of key products, and expanding translation services that support simultaneous Japanese and English disclosure, among others); growing new business areas (expanding orders for IR events, expanding talent recruitment support business that also uses alliances, and strengthening disclosure BPO, among others); ESG and sustainability strategy; and DX investment centered on system services, together with M&A. Toward the 100th anniversary of its founding in 2030, it has set a vision of becoming 'a niche top company group with no equal in the world, specializing in expertise', and aims to evolve into a 'corporate communication support' company that connects listed companies with all stakeholders on a one-stop basis.
